blocks.text: Bino, tadbir, shahar: at yoki in?

Binolar bilan ko'pincha ikkala predlog ham to'g'ri bo'ladi: **at** the station ham, **in** the station ham. Tanlov binoning o'ziga emas, **unga qanday qarayotganimizga** bog'liq. Agar joy — xaritadagi **nuqta**, biror ish qilinadigan, to'xtaladigan yoki uchrashiladigan manzil bo'lsa — **at**. Agar gap binoning **ichi**, uning devorlari ichidagi makon haqida bo'lsa — **in**. O'zbekchada farq yo'q («vokzalda»), kerak bo'lsa «vokzal **ichida**» deymiz. Asosiy iboralar (at the station, at a party, at Aziz's) qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 107-dars); bu darsda tanlov mantig'i, tadbirlar, kimningdir uyi, shahar va manzillar bilan chuqurroq ishlaymiz.

**at** binoni **faoliyat joyi** sifatida ko'rsatadi: vokzalda poyezd kutamiz, bankda pul ishlarini hal qilamiz, sport zalida shug'ullanamiz, pochtada posilka jo'natamiz: **at** the station, **at** the airport, **at** the bank, **at** the gym, **at** the post office, **at** the supermarket, **at** the library, **at** the museum, **at** the police station. Binoning ichida yoki eshik oldida ekanimiz muhim emas — muhimi, biz **o'sha joydamiz** va o'sha yerga xos ishni qilyapmiz. Uchrashuv joyi ham shunday: I'll meet you **at** the museum.

items.text: Sorry I didn't answer — I was **at the gym**.
We got there early and had a coffee **at the station**.
items.translation: U yerga erta yetib keldik va **vokzalda** qahva ichdik.

items.text: Let's meet **at the museum** at ten and look round together.
items.translation: Soat o'nda **muzeyda** uchrashib, birga aylanib chiqaylik.

blocks.text: **in** binoni **devorlari bor hajm** sifatida ko'rsatadi: ichidagi harorat, xonalar, do'konlar, odamlar haqida gapirganda. It was cold **in** the cinema (kinoteatr ichi sovuq edi), There are fifty shops **in** the airport, How many rooms are there **in** the hotel? Shuning uchun bitta gapda ikkalasi uchrashishi mumkin: I met Aziz **at** the airport — he was sitting **in** a café. Agar gap binoning o'zi haqida bo'lsa (eski, katta, qimmat) yoki u yerda nima borligi haqida bo'lsa — **in** tanlang.

items.text: It was so crowded **in the shop** that I left without buying anything.
items.translation: **Do'kon ichi** shunchalik gavjum ediki, hech narsa olmay chiqib ketdim.

items.text: There's a small pool **in the hotel**, but it's closed in winter.
items.translation: **Mehmonxonada** kichkina basseyn bor, lekin qishda yopiq bo'ladi.

blocks.text: Tadbirlar: at a party — lekin in a meeting

Tadbir — vaqt va joydagi **nuqta**, shuning uchun **at**: **at** a party, **at** a wedding, **at** a concert, **at** a conference, **at** a football match, **at** a funeral, **at** an exhibition, **at** the festival. Lekin jarayon **ichida** qatnashayotganimizni aytganda **in** ishlatiladi: She's **in a meeting** — u hozir yig'ilishda (band, chaqirib bo'lmaydi); **in class**, **in the lesson**, **in the lecture** — dars yoki ma'ruza paytida; **in the audience** — tomoshabinlar orasida. Guruh a'zoligi ham **in**: **in** the team, **in** a band, **in** the choir. Diqqat: **at** the party — ziyofatda, lekin **in** the party — siyosiy partiya a'zosi.

items.text: Did you meet anyone interesting **at the conference**?
Who sits next to you **in class**?
At seventeen, he was the youngest player **in the team**.
items.translation: O'n yetti yoshida u **jamoadagi** eng yosh o'yinchi edi.

blocks.text: at Aziz's, at the dentist's — kimningdir uyi va ish joyi

**at** + ism yoki kasb + `'s` — kimningdir uyi yoki ish joyi; **house**, **shop**, **surgery** so'zlari odatda tushib qoladi: **at** Aziz's — Azizlar**nikida**, **at** my parents' — ota-onam**nikida**, **at** the dentist's — tish shifokori**da**, **at** the hairdresser's — sartaroshxona**da**, **at** the chemist's — dorixona**da**. Ko'plikdagi `parents'` va `grandparents'` da apostrof oxirida keladi. So'zlashuvda **at** Tom's **place** ham juda ko'p ishlatiladi. O'zbekchadagi `-nikida` qo'shimchasi bu yerda eng yaxshi tarjima (`'s` haqida — 81-dars).

Shahar, qishloq va mamlakat — ichida yashaladigan hudud, shuning uchun odatda **in**: live **in** Tashkent, a flat **in** London. Lekin shaharni **yo'ldagi bir nuqta** sifatida ko'rsak — u yerda to'xtaymiz, almashtiramiz — **at**: The train stops **at** Samarkand; We changed planes **at** Heathrow. Aeroport va bekat nomlari bilan ham **at**. Ko'chada British English **in** ni afzal ko'radi (**in** Oxford Street), **on** ham uchraydi; aniq manzil, ya'ni uy raqami bilan — **at**: **at** 25 Navoi Street. Tuman va mahalla — **in**: **in** Yunusabad, **in** central London. arrive **in** / **at** — 126-darsda.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I was in a party» → **at a party**; «She can't talk, she's at a meeting» (hozir band) → **in a meeting**; «in Aziz's» → **at Aziz's**; «at my parents house» → **at my parents'** (yoki at my parents' house); «I live at Tashkent» → **in Tashkent**; «in 25 Navoi Street» → **at 25 Navoi Street**; «It was cold at the cinema» (zal ichi) → **in the cinema**; «He is in the party» (ziyofatda ma'nosida) → **at the party**.

O'zingizdan so'rang: «**Xaritadagi nuqtami yoki devorlar ichidagi makonmi?**» Biror ish qilinadigan, to'xtaladigan, uchrashiladigan manzil — **at**; ichidagi harorat, xonalar, odamlar — **in**. Shahar — doim ichida yashaladigan hudud (**in**), faqat yo'lda bir lahza to'xtasangiz — **at**.

Bog'lanish: in / at / on ning asosiy mantig'i — 123-dars; in bed, at home, in hospital (artiklsiz) — 124-dars; go to, arrive in / at, get to, into — 126-dars; egalik `'s` (at Aziz's) — 81-dars; school / the school — 74-dars.

items: **at** + bino — faoliyat joyi, uchrashuv nuqtasi: **at** the station, **at** the bank, **at** the gym, **at** the museum.
**in** + bino — ichki makon: cold **in** the cinema, shops **in** the airport, rooms **in** the hotel.
**at** + tadbir: **at** a party, **at** a wedding, **at** a conference; lekin jarayon ichida — **in** a meeting, **in** class, **in** the audience; a'zolik — **in** the team.
**at** + ism / kasb + `'s`: **at** Aziz's, **at** my parents', **at** the dentist's.
Shahar — **in** Tashkent; yo'ldagi to'xtash — **at** Samarkand; ko'cha — **in** Oxford Street; aniq manzil — **at** 25 Navoi Street.

examples.title: **at** the station, **at** the bank: places for doing things
examples.description: at — bino faoliyat joyi yoki nuqta sifatida: u yerda nima qilinishi (poyezd kutish, pul ishlari, mashq qilish) muhim, binoning ichi emas.

sentences.text: I'll pick you up **at the station** — just call me when your train gets in.
sentences.translation: Seni **vokzalda** kutib olaman — poyezding yetib kelganda qo'ng'iroq qilsang bas.

sentences.text: Madina spent two hours **at the bank** trying to sort out a problem with her card.
sentences.translation: Madina kartasidagi muammoni hal qilishga urinib, **bankda** ikki soat o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: We were stuck **at the airport** all night because of the fog in London.
sentences.translation: Londondagi tuman tufayli butun tun **aeroportda** qolib ketdik.

sentences.text: Oliver goes running in the morning and works out **at the gym** after work.
sentences.translation: Oliver ertalab yuguradi, ishdan keyin esa **sport zalida** shug'ullanadi.

sentences.text: Is there a cashpoint **at the supermarket**, or do I need to go to the bank?
sentences.translation: **Supermarketda** bankomat bormi yoki bankka borishim kerakmi?

sentences.text: I bumped into my old English teacher **at the post office** this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **pochtada** eski ingliz tili o'qituvchimni uchratib qoldim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza prefers to revise **at the library**, where her brothers can't disturb her.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ukalari xalaqit bera olmaydigan joyda — **kutubxonada** takrorlashni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: Let's have dinner **at the hotel** tonight — I'm too tired to go out.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **mehmonxonada** ovqatlanaylik — tashqariga chiqishga juda charchaganman.

sentences.text: There was a long queue **at the museum**, so we went to a café instead.
sentences.translation: **Muzeyda** uzun navbat bor edi, shuning uchun uning o'rniga kafega bordik.

sentences.text: What were you doing **at the police station**? — I had to report my stolen bike.
sentences.translation: **Politsiya bo'limida** nima qilayotgan eding? — O'g'irlangan velosipedim haqida ariza berishim kerak edi.

examples.title: **in** the station, **in** the museum: inside the building
examples.description: in — binoning ichi haqida gapirganda: harorat, xonalar, do'konlar, odamlar. Bir binoning o'zi bilan at (faoliyat) va in (ichki makon) farqi.

sentences.text: It was so cold **in the station** that we waited outside in the sun.
sentences.translation: **Vokzal ichi** shunchalik sovuq ediki, tashqarida, quyoshda kutdik.

sentences.text: There are more than fifty shops and restaurants **in the airport**.
sentences.translation: **Aeroport ichida** ellikdan ortiq do'kon va restoran bor.

sentences.text: Photography isn't allowed **in the museum**, so leave your camera at the entrance.
sentences.translation: **Muzey ichida** suratga olish mumkin emas, shuning uchun kamerangizni kirishda qoldiring.

sentences.text: We went to see a film last night, but it was freezing **in the cinema**.
sentences.translation: Kecha kino ko'rgani bordik, lekin **kinoteatr ichi** muzdek edi.

sentences.text: How many rooms are there **in the hotel**? — About three hundred, I think.
sentences.translation: **Mehmonxonada** nechta xona bor? — Menimcha, uch yuzga yaqin.

sentences.text: There were only a few customers **in the bank** when the robbers came in.
sentences.translation: Qaroqchilar kirib kelganda **bank ichida** atigi bir nechta mijoz bor edi.

sentences.text: The lights went out, and everyone **in the theatre** started using their phones as torches.
sentences.translation: Chiroqlar o'chdi va **teatrdagi** hamma telefonini fonar qilib ishlata boshladi.

sentences.text: Is there a lift **in the building**, or do we have to carry the sofa upstairs?
sentences.translation: **Binoda** lift bormi yoki divanni yuqoriga ko'tarib chiqishimiz kerakmi?

sentences.text: I met Aziz **at the airport** — he was sitting **in a café** near gate 5.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan **aeroportda** uchrashdim — u 5-chiqish eshigi yonidagi **kafeda** o'tirgan ekan.

sentences.text: The air **in the old library** smelled of dust and leather.
sentences.translation: **Eski kutubxona ichidagi** havodan chang va charm hidi kelardi.

examples.title: **at** a party, **at** a wedding, **at** a conference
examples.description: Tadbirlar — at: at a wedding, at a festival, at a conference, at a concert, at a funeral, at a match, at an exhibition, at a meeting.

sentences.text: Sarah and Tom met **at a friend's wedding** in Edinburgh three years ago.
sentences.translation: Sara va Tom uch yil oldin Edinburgda **bir do'stining to'yida** tanishishgan.

sentences.text: Did you see anyone famous **at the film festival**?
sentences.translation: **Kinofestivalda** biror mashhur odamni ko'rdingmi?

sentences.text: I'm giving a talk **at an IT conference** in Samarkand next month.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy Samarqanddagi **IT konferensiyasida** ma'ruza qilaman.

sentences.text: Thousands of fans were singing **at the concert**, so we could hardly hear the band.
sentences.translation: **Konsertda** minglab muxlislar qo'shiq aytayotgan edi, shuning uchun guruhni deyarli eshitmadik.

sentences.text: There were more than five hundred guests **at Bekzod's wedding**.
sentences.translation: **Bekzodning to'yida** besh yuzdan ortiq mehmon bor edi.

sentences.text: Many of his former colleagues spoke **at the funeral**.
sentences.translation: **Dafn marosimida** uning ko'plab sobiq hamkasblari so'zga chiqdi.

sentences.text: Emma lost her voice after shouting all afternoon **at the football match**.
sentences.translation: Emma butun tushdan keyin **futbol o'yinida** baqirib, ovozini yo'qotib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Who was the man you were talking to **at the party** last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha **ziyofatda** gaplashib turgan odaming kim edi?

sentences.text: Our company had a stand **at the exhibition**, and we made lots of new contacts.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamizning **ko'rgazmada** stendi bor edi va ko'plab yangi aloqalar orttirdik.

sentences.text: Nobody **at the meeting** dared to disagree with the new director.
sentences.translation: **Yig'ilishda** hech kim yangi direktorga e'tiroz bildirishga jur'at etmadi.

examples.title: **in a meeting**, **in class**, **in the team**
examples.description: in a meeting, in class, in the lecture — hozir shu jarayon ichida qatnashyapti; in the audience — tomoshabinlar orasida; in the team, in a band — a'zo. at the meeting — tadbir sifatida.

sentences.text: I'm sorry, Ms Karimova is **in a meeting** until three. Can I take a message?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Karimova xonim soat uchgacha **yig'ilishda**. Biror gap yetkazib qo'yaymi?

sentences.text: Phones must be switched off **in class**, and that includes the teacher's!
sentences.translation: **Dars paytida** telefonlar o'chirilgan bo'lishi kerak, o'qituvchiniki ham!

sentences.text: What did you learn **in today's lesson**? — How to use prepositions with places!
sentences.translation: **Bugungi darsda** nima o'rgandingiz? — Joy predloglarini qanday ishlatishni!

sentences.text: My brother plays the drums **in a rock band**, so our flat is never quiet.
sentences.translation: Akam **rok guruhida** baraban chaladi, shuning uchun uyimiz hech qachon jim bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Was Jasur **at the meeting** yesterday? — No, he was off sick.
sentences.translation: Kecha Jasur **yig'ilishda** bormidi? — Yo'q, kasal bo'lib ishga chiqmagan edi.

sentences.text: There are eleven players **in a football team**, but only one can use his hands.
sentences.translation: **Futbol jamoasida** o'n bitta o'yinchi bor, lekin faqat bittasi qo'llarini ishlata oladi.

sentences.text: Two students fell asleep **in the lecture** because the room was so warm.
sentences.translation: Xona juda iliq bo'lgani uchun ikki talaba **ma'ruza paytida** uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: Nilufar can't answer her phone — she's **in an interview** with a big tech company.
sentences.translation: Nilufar telefonini ko'tara olmaydi — u katta texnologiya kompaniyasi bilan **suhbatda**.

sentences.text: Somebody **in the audience** started coughing loudly just as the pianist began.
sentences.translation: Pianinochi chalishni boshlagan zahoti **tomoshabinlar orasidan** kimdir qattiq yo'tala boshladi.

sentences.text: Is your daughter still **in the school choir**? She sang beautifully **at the concert**.
sentences.translation: Qizingiz hali ham **maktab xorida** kuylaydimi? U **konsertda** juda chiroyli kuyladi.

examples.title: **at** Aziz's, **at** the dentist's, **at** my parents'
examples.description: at + ism yoki kasb + 's — kimningdir uyi yoki ish joyi: at Aziz's (Azizlarnikida), at my grandparents' (buvamlarnikida), at the dentist's, at the hairdresser's. house, shop so'zlari tushib qoladi.

sentences.text: We're having dinner **at Aziz's** tonight — his mother is making plov.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **Azizlarnikida** ovqatlanamiz — onasi palov damlayapti.

sentences.text: I spent the whole morning **at the dentist's**, and my face still feels numb.
sentences.translation: Butun ertalabni **tish shifokorida** o'tkazdim, yuzim hali ham uvushib turibdi.

sentences.text: Kate is staying **at her sister's** until her new flat is ready.
sentences.translation: Keyt yangi kvartirasi tayyor bo'lguncha **opasinikida** yashab turibdi.

sentences.text: Can you pick up my prescription **at the chemist's** on your way home?
sentences.translation: Uyga kelayotib **dorixonadan** retsept bo'yicha dorimni olib kela olasanmi?

sentences.text: Where's Grandma? — She's **at the hairdresser's**; she'll be back by lunchtime.
sentences.translation: Buvim qani? — **Sartaroshxonada**; tushlikkacha qaytib keladi.

sentences.text: The party is **at Tom's place**, not at the restaurant as we planned.
sentences.translation: Ziyofat biz rejalashtirgandek restoranda emas, **Tomning uyida** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My car has been **at the mechanic's** for a week, so I'm taking the metro.
sentences.translation: Mashinam bir haftadan beri **ustaxonada**, shuning uchun metroda qatnayapman.

sentences.text: Every Sunday we have lunch **at my grandparents'** in Chilanzar.
sentences.translation: Har yakshanba Chilonzordagi **buvamlarnikida** tushlik qilamiz.

sentences.text: Were you **at the doctor's** this morning? — Yes, just for a blood test.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **shifokor qabulida** edingizmi? — Ha, faqat qon tahlili uchun.

sentences.text: Dilnoza bought the most delicious cake **at the baker's** near the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bozor yaqinidagi **qandolatchilik do'konidan** eng mazali tortni sotib oldi.

examples.title: Cities: **in** Tashkent, but stop **at** Samarkand
examples.description: Shahar, qishloq, mamlakat — in: live in Tashkent, work in Manchester. Yo'ldagi to'xtash nuqtasi — at: The train stops at Samarkand, we stopped at a village. Aeroport nomi — at.

sentences.text: Jasur has lived **in Tashkent** all his life, but his parents come from Khorezm.
sentences.translation: Jasur butun umri **Toshkentda** yashagan, lekin ota-onasi Xorazmdan.

sentences.text: Does this train stop **at Samarkand**, or does it go straight to Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Bu poyezd **Samarqandda** to'xtaydimi yoki to'g'ri Buxoroga boradimi?

sentences.text: We changed planes **at Heathrow** and had three hours to kill.
sentences.translation: **Xitrou aeroportida** samolyot almashtirdik va uch soat bo'sh vaqtimiz bor edi.

sentences.text: Life **in a big city** like London can be exciting but very expensive.
sentences.translation: London kabi **katta shaharda** hayot qiziqarli, lekin juda qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: On the way to Khiva, we stopped **at a small village** for lunch.
sentences.translation: Xivaga ketayotib, tushlik uchun **kichik bir qishloqda** to'xtadik.

sentences.text: My cousin works as an engineer **in Manchester**, so I visit him every summer.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham **Manchesterda** muhandis bo'lib ishlaydi, shuning uchun har yozda uning oldiga boraman.

sentences.text: The night bus calls **at Jizzakh** and Gulistan before it reaches Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Tungi avtobus Toshkentga yetib kelishdan oldin **Jizzaxda** va Gulistonda to'xtaydi.

sentences.text: Almost a third of Uzbekistan's population lives **in the Fergana Valley**.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston aholisining qariyb uchdan bir qismi **Farg'ona vodiysida** yashaydi.

sentences.text: Our flight lands **at Tashkent airport** at 6 a.m., so we'll be **in the city** by eight.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz ertalab soat 6 da **Toshkent aeroportiga** qo'nadi, demak soat sakkizgacha **shaharda** bo'lamiz.

sentences.text: Have you ever been to Oxford? — Yes, my sister studied **in Oxford** for two years.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, opam ikki yil **Oksfordda** o'qigan.

examples.title: Addresses: **at** 12 Navoi Street, **in** Oxford Street
examples.description: Aniq manzil (uy raqami bilan) — at: at 12 Navoi Street, at this address, at number 7. Ko'cha raqamsiz — British English da in: in Oxford Street, in a quiet street. Tuman — in: in Yunusabad.

sentences.text: The language school is **at 12 Navoi Street**, on the second floor.
sentences.translation: Til maktabi **Navoiy ko'chasi, 12-uyda**, ikkinchi qavatda joylashgan.

sentences.text: Sherlock Holmes famously lived **at 221B Baker Street** in London.
sentences.translation: Sherlok Xolms Londondagi **Beyker-strit, 221B** manzilida yashagani hammaga ma'lum.

sentences.text: There are dozens of shops **in Oxford Street**, and it's always crowded.
sentences.translation: **Oksford-stritda** o'nlab do'konlar bor va u doim gavjum.

sentences.text: Please check your details — do you still live **at number 7**?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ma'lumotlaringizni tekshiring — hali ham **7-uyda** yashaysizmi?

sentences.text: Madina's family has a house **in Yunusabad**, not far from the TV tower.
sentences.translation: Madinaning oilasining **Yunusobodda**, teleminoradan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan joyda uyi bor.

sentences.text: Nobody was **at the address** that the delivery company gave us.
sentences.translation: Yetkazib berish kompaniyasi bergan **manzilda** hech kim yo'q edi.

sentences.text: My grandparents lived **in the same street** for over fifty years.
sentences.translation: Buvam va buvim ellik yildan ortiq **bitta ko'chada** yashashgan.

sentences.text: Is the bank **in this street**, or is it round the corner?
sentences.translation: Bank **shu ko'chadami** yoki muyulishning narigi tomonidami?

sentences.text: We used to live **at 14 Park Road**, but the house has been sold.
sentences.translation: Biz ilgari **Park-roud, 14-uyda** yashardik, lekin u uy sotib yuborilgan.

sentences.text: Kate rents a tiny room **in a quiet street** near the university.
sentences.translation: Keyt universitet yaqinidagi **tinch bir ko'chada** kichkina xona ijaraga oladi.

examples.title: Dialogue: where were you all weekend?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashadi — tadbir, kimningdir uyi, bino va uning ichi bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Where were you on Saturday? I called, but nobody was **at home**.
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni qayerda eding? Qo'ng'iroq qildim, lekin **uyda** hech kim yo'q edi.

sentences.text: — Sorry! We were **at a wedding** in Samarkand — my cousin got married.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasan! Samarqanddagi **to'yda** edik — amakivachcham turmush qurdi.

sentences.text: — Lovely! Did you stay **in a hotel** or **at your relatives'**?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! **Mehmonxonada** qoldingizmi yoki **qarindoshlaringiznikida**?

sentences.text: — **At my aunt's**. She has a big house **in the old town**, near the Registan.
sentences.translation: — **Xolamnikida**. Uning **eski shaharda**, Registon yaqinida katta uyi bor.

sentences.text: — And what about Sunday? Were you **at the cinema** again?
sentences.translation: — Yakshanba-chi? Yana **kinoteatrda** edingmi?

sentences.text: — No, we spent half the day **at the station** because our train was cancelled.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, poyezdimiz bekor qilingani uchun kunning yarmini **vokzalda** o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: — Oh no! Was it at least warm **in the station**?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Hech bo'lmasa **vokzal ichi** iliqmidi?

sentences.text: — Not really. We drank tea **in a little café** to keep warm.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Isinish uchun **kichkina bir kafeda** choy ichdik.

sentences.text: — Poor you. So are you **at work** today, or still resting?
sentences.translation: — Bechora. Xo'sh, bugun **ishdamisan** yoki hali dam olyapsanmi?

sentences.text: — **At work**, unfortunately, and I'm **in a meeting** in five minutes!
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, **ishdaman**, besh daqiqadan keyin esa **yig'ilishga** kiraman!
